[USER] User requested a description of how to make an axis in Inventor and use the program utilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To create an axis in Autodesk Inventor:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Open Autodesk Inventor and create a new part file.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Click on the "Axis" tool from the "3D Model" tab of the toolbar or from the "Create" dropdown menu.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Click on the face or edge where you want to create the axis.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Define the orientation and location of the axis by specifying two points or using options like "Parallel" or "Perpendicular" to existing geometry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Click "OK" to create the axis.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To use program utilities in Inventor, examples include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Measure" tool: Measure distances, angles, and other properties of geometry, accessed from the "Inspect" dropdown menu or shortcut key "M".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Pattern" tool: Create patterns of features or components, accessed from the "Pattern" dropdown menu or shortcut key "P".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Mirror" tool: Create a mirrored copy of a feature or component, accessed from the "Pattern" dropdown menu or shortcut key "M".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Extrude" tool: Create a 3D solid from a 2D sketch, accessed from the "3D Model" tab or shortcut key "E".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Fillet" tool: Add a rounded edge to a sharp corner, accessed from the "3D Model" tab or shortcut key "F".
